issue_context.title: HttpClient hangs if an internet connection isn't available
issue_context.body:
Regression from #18995.

Where `WebClient` would return with an error that the game can then handle gracefully, `HttpClient` instead hangs. This breaks a bunch of things, with one easy and serious repro case being when attempting to host a LAN game:

1. Link to a forum account, if not already
2. Disable Wifi / unplug ethernet cable
3. Launch the game
4. Create a server through the Multiplayer menu

The player will now be faced with a blank lobby window, followed by a "Connection Failed" dialog if they attempt to send a chat message.

review_comments: I don't think so - lack of an internet connection isn't *that* unusual (considering that this code is triggered from the main menu on launch), and we have a couple of other cases where failed queries don't log.
